related.title: pfSense：狀態表容量與規則變更驗證
related.titleEn: pfSense: state-table capacity and rule-change validation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：40案都有預期結果且管理回復路徑可用；新增區不使原24案授權擴大。 交付24/40案流向矩陣、狀態轉換表與更新/回復程序。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All 40 cases have expectations and management recovery remains available; adding a zone does not broaden the original 24 permissions. Deliver 24/40-case matrices, state transitions and update/rollback procedure.
related.difference: 把規則允許、NAT轉換與已建立state分三層；使用合成連線到達率與生命期，估算穩態state需求而不執行壓力攻擊。
related.differenceEn: Separate rule permission, NAT translation and established state; estimate steady-state demand from synthetic arrivals and lifetimes without traffic attacks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 不含自連的有向區間測試數=Z(Z−1)S；連線回程必須依狀態解釋，不能把反向新連線與回應封包混為一談。 Z=4區、S=2類服務；本題只數新連線政策組合。 4×3×2=24案；新增一個設備區後5×4×2=40案。
在穩態且沒有提前回收的簡化模型，平均states≈每秒新連線λ×平均生命W；尖峰與重傳需另留容量。 λ=400個新連線/秒，平均W=30秒；流量平穩且每連線占一個state。 400×30=12000個state；平均生命延至60秒時為24000個。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Directed interzone test count excluding self-links is Z(Z−1)S; interpret return traffic by state rather than equating replies with reverse new connections. Z=4 zones and S=2 service classes; count only new-connection policy combinations. 4×3×2=24 cases; adding a device zone gives 5×4×2=40.

In a simplified steady state without early eviction, average states≈arrival rate λ×mean lifetime W; bursts and retries need separate headroom. λ=400 new connections per second and W=30 seconds, with steady arrivals and one state per connection. 400×30=12000 states; lifetime 60 seconds yields 24000.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Sigma 偵測規則：布林條件與誤報真值表
related.titleEn: Sigma detections: Boolean conditions and false-positive truth tables
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：40案都有預期結果且管理回復路徑可用；新增區不使原24案授權擴大。 交付24/40案流向矩陣、狀態轉換表與更新/回復程序。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All 40 cases have expectations and management recovery remains available; adding a zone does not broaden the original 24 permissions. Deliver 24/40-case matrices, state transitions and update/rollback procedure.
related.difference: 為無害的合成程序日誌設計selection與filter；先列AND、OR與NOT真值表，再將每個測試案例連到規則預期，避免直接套到正式告警。
related.differenceEn: Design selection and filter over harmless synthetic process logs; enumerate AND/OR/NOT truth tables and bind each fixture to expected behavior before production alerting.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 不含自連的有向區間測試數=Z(Z−1)S；連線回程必須依狀態解釋，不能把反向新連線與回應封包混為一談。 Z=4區、S=2類服務；本題只數新連線政策組合。 4×3×2=24案；新增一個設備區後5×4×2=40案。
precision=TP/(TP+FP)，recall=TP/(TP+FN)；修改過濾器時兩者都要檢查，不能只減少警報。 固定測試集有20個應偵測樣本與80個正常樣本；TP18、FN2、FP6、TN74。 precision=18/(18+6)×100=75%，recall=90%；FP降2且TP維持18時precision=90%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Directed interzone test count excluding self-links is Z(Z−1)S; interpret return traffic by state rather than equating replies with reverse new connections. Z=4 zones and S=2 service classes; count only new-connection policy combinations. 4×3×2=24 cases; adding a device zone gives 5×4×2=40.

Precision=TP/(TP+FP) and recall=TP/(TP+FN); evaluate both after filtering changes instead of only reducing alert volume. A fixed set has 20 labeled positives and 80 normal fixtures: TP18, FN2, FP6 and TN74. Precision=18/(18+6)×100=75% and recall=90%; reducing FP to 2 with TP18 yields precision 90%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
